Yes, there is a production service mesh lab on puffin, but it is not the one with "Service Mesh" in its title.

Searching the puffin catalog for "service mesh" returns two items:

- OpenShift Traffic Management Lab - ci_name netsvc.traffic-mgmt-lab, namespace babylon-catalog-prod, stage prod, asset UUID 0d9a4e71-c2b5-4f38-8a6d-e15f3b72c904. Its display name doesn't mention service mesh; it matched on its keywords (service mesh, istio, traffic routing, canary). This is the one to order for the customer demo. It is single-user (multiuser: false), so each attendee needs their own order.
- Service Mesh Deep Dive - ci_name netsvc.mesh-deep-dive, namespace babylon-catalog-dev, stage dev. It is a dev-stage item, so it is not suitable for a customer-facing demo.

So order netsvc.traffic-mgmt-lab (OpenShift Traffic Management Lab, prod).
